title: Excellent Excursion
text:
What a gem of an excursion in the capable hands of our guide Ivan who shared his incomparable knowledge and experience. Excellent transfers. Stunning locations with 5 star cuisine at lunchtime. 
This really gave us a fabulous start to our holiday. Huge thanks, Ivan! Much appreciated

title: Thanks so much Ale!!
text: Ale was amazing!!! The fact that he gave us history and a wine experience in one was incredible. He was so knowledgeable about everything and honestly a good time the entire tour. Sometimes these tours can get stuffy but Ale was upbeat, timely and very thorough about details. Thank you so much for making my friends 35th birthday in Barcelona one to remember!! He even gave her a birthday cake with candles at the wine meetup. Extremely sweet and thoughtful. Thank you again!
author: 578demetriaw

title: Amazing tour. For those...
text: Amazing tour. For those who grew up in the mountains, Monserrat was a bit underwhelming  but still pretty. Our tour guide, Thaís was incredible, so funny, and kept us entertained throughout though. She was very knowledgeable about wine, it was very impressive. The winery was gorgeous with Monserrat in the background, and you get nice pours. Overall 10/10
author: Bristi_B

title: Great sites, guide and wine…tapas not so much
text: MARCALR tour guide was great. All the accommodations were top-notch. The tapas was just acceptable, but the wine was good.
author: RobLI12

title: Funny and enjoyable
text: The tour is well organized and the staff are well informed and professional. There is good variety in the tour. Our guide Xavi was very funny and helpful.
